title: Chicken Caesar Wraps with Lemon Chicken and Crunchy Panko
summary: Thin chicken cutlets are seared to 74 °C and sliced, romaine is tossed in a creamy anchovy-Parmesan dressing, and both are rolled into warmed tortillas with toasted panko.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
anchovy fillets in oil, drained and mashed

steps.title: Prepare the chicken
steps.text: Slice each breast horizontally into 2 thin cutlets and pound them to an even 1.5 cm between sheets of baking paper. Rub with the oil, salt and pepper.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.text: Heat the large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the cutlets 3-4 minutes per side until golden and 74 °C in the thickest part. Rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips.

steps.title: Toast the panko
steps.text: Toast the panko in the oil in the small pan over medium heat, stirring, for 2-3 minutes until golden. Tip onto a plate so it stops cooking.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, Parmesan, lemon juice, garlic, mashed anchovy, mustard powder and pepper together in the medium bowl.

steps.title: Dress the lettuce
steps.text: Toss the romaine with two-thirds of the dressing in the large bowl.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Warm each tortilla in the dry large pan for about 15 seconds per side so it folds without cracking.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Spread a little of the remaining dressing down the middle of each tortilla. Add a quarter of the lettuce and chicken, scatter with panko, fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Cut in half on the diagonal and serve.

tips: Pounding the chicken evenly means it cooks through before the outside dries out.
Add the panko at the last moment so it stays crunchy.
Wrap each roll tightly in baking paper if you want to eat it on the go.
storage: Best eaten within an hour of rolling. Keep leftover chicken and dressing separately in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
